@@ -0,0 +1,125 @@
+name: Bootstrap and validate Mawdda native platforms
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - codex/mawda-full-platform-implementation
+    paths:
+      - "tool/configure_native_platforms.py"
+      - ".github/workflows/bootstrap-native-platforms.yml"
+      - "pubspec.yaml"
+      - "pubspec.lock"
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: write
+
+concurrency:
+  group: mawdda-native-platform-bootstrap
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  generate-and-build-android:
+    name: Generate native runners and build Android
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 35
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
+        with:
+          ref: codex/mawda-full-platform-implementation
+
+      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
+        with:
+          flutter-version: "3.47.9"
+          channel: stable
+          cache: true
+
+      - name: Generate missing Android and iOS runners
+        run: |
+          if [ ! -d android ] || [ ! -d ios ]; then
+            flutter create --platforms=android,ios --org com.mawdda.platform --project-name app .
+          fi
+          python3 tool/configure_native_platforms.py
+
+      - name: Resolve locked Flutter dependencies
+        run: flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile
+
+      - name: Build Android debug APK
+        run: flutter build apk --debug
+
+      - name: Package generated native projects
+        run: tar -czf native-platforms.tar.gz android ios
+
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
+        with:
+          name: mawdda-native-platforms-${{ github.sha }}
+          path: native-platforms.tar.gz
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 14
+
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
+        with:
+          name: mawdda-android-debug-${{ github.sha }}
+          path: build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 14
+
+  build-ios:
+    name: Build iOS without code signing
+    needs: generate-and-build-android
+    runs-on: macos-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 45
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
+        with:
+          ref: codex/mawda-full-platform-implementation
+
+      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
+        with:
+          flutter-version: "3.47.9"
+          channel: stable
+          cache: true
+
+      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v5
+        with:
+          name: mawdda-native-platforms-${{ github.sha }}
+          path: native-artifact
+
+      - name: Restore generated iOS project
+        run: tar -xzf native-artifact/native-platforms.tar.gz -C .
+
+      - name: Resolve locked Flutter dependencies
+        run: flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile
+
+      - name: Build iOS without signing
+        run: flutter build ios --no-codesign
+
+  commit-native-projects:
+    name: Commit validated native project scaffolding
+    needs:
+      - generate-and-build-android
+      - build-ios
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
+        with:
+          ref: codex/mawda-full-platform-implementation
+          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+
+      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v5
+        with:
+          name: mawdda-native-platforms-${{ github.sha }}
+          path: native-artifact
+
+      - name: Add generated platform directories
+        run: |
+          tar -xzf native-artifact/native-platforms.tar.gz -C .
+          git add android ios
+          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
+            echo "Native platform scaffolding is already current."
+            exit 0
+          fi
+          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
+          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
+          git commit -m "build: add validated Android and iOS native runners"
+          git push origin HEAD:codex/mawda-full-platform-implementation

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Apply Mawdda's native configuration after Flutter creates Android/iOS runners."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import plistlib
+import re
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+PACKAGE = "com.mawdda.platform.app"
+APP_NAME = "Mawdda Platform 2026"
+
+
+def configure_android() -> None:
+    android = ROOT / "android"
+    if not android.is_dir():
+        raise SystemExit("Flutter did not generate the Android project directory.")
+
+    candidates = list((android / "app" / "src" / "main").rglob("MainActivity.kt"))
+    if candidates:
+        activity = candidates[0]
+        package_match = re.search(r"^package\s+([A-Za-z0-9_.]+)", activity.read_text(), re.M)
+        package = package_match.group(1) if package_match else PACKAGE
+        activity.write_text(
+            f"package {package}\n\n"
+            "import io.flutter.embedding.android.FlutterFragmentActivity\n\n"
+            "class MainActivity : FlutterFragmentActivity()\n",
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+    else:
+        java_candidates = list((android / "app" / "src" / "main").rglob("MainActivity.java"))
+        if not java_candidates:
+            raise SystemExit("Flutter-generated MainActivity source was not found.")
+        activity = java_candidates[0]
+        package_match = re.search(r"^package\s+([A-Za-z0-9_.]+)", activity.read_text(), re.M)
+        package = package_match.group(1) if package_match else PACKAGE
+        activity.write_text(
+            f"package {package};\n\n"
+            "import io.flutter.embedding.android.FlutterFragmentActivity;\n\n"
+            "public class MainActivity extends FlutterFragmentActivity {}\n",
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+
+    manifest = android / "app" / "src" / "main" / "AndroidManifest.xml"
+    xml = manifest.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    permissions = [
+        '    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC" />',
+        '    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.USE_FINGERPRINT" />',
+        '    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS" />',
+    ]
+    for permission in permissions:
+        if permission not in xml:
+            xml = xml.replace("<application", permission + "\n    <application", 1)
+    xml = re.sub(r'android:label="[^"]+"', f'android:label="{APP_NAME}"', xml, count=1)
+    manifest.write_text(xml, encoding="utf-8")
+
+    gradle_files = [
+        android / "app" / "build.gradle.kts",
+        android / "app" / "build.gradle",
+    ]
+    gradle = next((candidate for candidate in gradle_files if candidate.is_file()), None)
+    if gradle is None:
+        raise SystemExit("Android app Gradle build file was not generated.")
+    source = gradle.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    if gradle.suffix == ".kts":
+        source, namespace_count = re.subn(
+            r'namespace\s*=\s*"[^"]+"',
+            f'namespace = "{PACKAGE}"',
+            source,
+            count=1,
+        )
+        source, app_id_count = re.subn(
+            r'applicationId\s*=\s*"[^"]+"',
+            f'applicationId = "{PACKAGE}"',
+            source,
+            count=1,
+        )
+        source, min_count = re.subn(
+            r'minSdk\s*=\s*flutter\.minSdkVersion',
+            "minSdk = 23",
+            source,
+            count=1,
+        )
+    else:
+        source, namespace_count = re.subn(
+            r'namespace\s+["\'][^"\']+["\']',
+            f'namespace "{PACKAGE}"',
+            source,
+            count=1,
+        )
+        source, app_id_count = re.subn(
+            r'applicationId\s+["\'][^"\']+["\']',
+            f'applicationId "{PACKAGE}"',
+            source,
+            count=1,
+        )
+        source, min_count = re.subn(
+            r'minSdkVersion\s+flutter\.minSdkVersion',
+            "minSdkVersion 23",
+            source,
+            count=1,
+        )
+    if not namespace_count or not app_id_count or not min_count:
+        raise SystemExit("Could not safely set Android namespace, applicationId and minSdk=23.")
+    gradle.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def configure_ios() -> None:
+    ios = ROOT / "ios"
+    info = ios / "Runner" / "Info.plist"
+    if not info.is_file():
+        raise SystemExit("Flutter did not generate ios/Runner/Info.plist.")
+    with info.open("rb") as handle:
+        values = plistlib.load(handle)
+    values["CFBundleDisplayName"] = APP_NAME
+    values["NSFaceIDUsageDescription"] = (
+        "Mawdda uses Face ID only when you explicitly choose local device authentication. "
+        "Biometric data remains on your Apple device and is never collected by Mawdda."
+    )
+    with info.open("wb") as handle:
+        plistlib.dump(values, handle, sort_keys=False)
+
+    project = ios / "Runner.xcodeproj" / "project.pbxproj"
+    if not project.is_file():
+        raise SystemExit("Flutter did not generate the Runner Xcode project.")
+    pbx = project.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    if f"PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER = {PACKAGE};" not in pbx:
+        pbx, count = re.subn(
+            r"PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER = com\.example\.app;",
+            f"PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER = {PACKAGE};",
+            pbx,
+        )
+        if count == 0:
+            raise SystemExit("Could not verify/set the iOS bundle identifier.")
+    project.write_text(pbx, encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    configure_android()
+    configure_ios()
+    print("Mawdda Android/iOS native configuration applied.")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
